title: ToolRunStartedPayload

tool.description: The tool installed or updated: bao for vault's Install.

action.description: What tools.run does: install (a tool not installed) or update (one installed by a method the harness drives); a Copy-only row runs nothing.

method.description: A way the harness installs or updates a tool: homebrew; winget; apt or dnf, the vendor's repository added with its signing key; script, the vendor's install script (claude's native installer among them); npm, a global package, which it only updates.

terminalId.description: The tool terminal the command runs in, so its id is never used again.

command.description: The command line the login shell runs.

description: tool.run-started: a client session began installing or updating a tool in a tool terminal: the tool, the action, the method, the terminal and the command line.
